description: Re-run of the interrupted C03 budget probe (normalized coordinates, paused inference, 64 calls) on the development world. Differences from C03: combat render barrier (first frame waits for a live target heartbeat + 0.25 s) and bounded provider retries. Local cap raised 0.60 -> 0.75 so the per-call reservation does not end the episode before 64 calls. Adaptive feasibility probe, not a rate.
